scaling_source: Engineering unit scales fixed before the experiment; no scaler or bandwidth fit to the compared groups
inference_scope: Exchangeability is not established for overlapping IoT windows or reused reference samples. Tail fraction and alert are diagnostics, not calibrated p-values or false-alarm guarantees. No automatic retraining or model-quality claim.
sampling: No implicit subsampling. Oversized unique groups are rejected before Gram matrix allocation. Caller must define a bounded cohort before inspecting its comparison.
